source.operation: arbitrary waveform CSV/DAC upload command construction
source.transport: offline saved bytes; optional USB CDC serial transport (not exercised)

manual.title: AFG-2225 Series User Manual
manual.location: REMOTE INTERFACE, PDF pp. 180-265; local copy ref/编程手册.pdf

data.raw_provenance: Synthetic fixture following the manual's documented DATA:DAC example; not a real instrument capture.

known_limitations: No hardware verification is included; the optional USB CDC transport is untested.
USB CDC identity (0x2184:0x001c) is external/Linux-kernel evidence, not manual text.
Binary ARB byte order is unverified; ASCII decimal list is the default safe path.
The manual's DATA:DAC example claims 5 values / 16 bytes; actual byte count is 10 bytes. This is a documented manual defect.
No LAN, GPIB, or RS-232 interface; USB device port only.
115200 8N1 is an assumption, not a manual default.
